objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperless document in DHC VISION, including policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected for a document; examples include policy, guideline, procedural instruction and work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained for relevant IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained for relevant companies.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained for areas of validity.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document, adaptable to requirements.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document, adaptable to requirements.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained automatically or by the user.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version information of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document, including editing, released and out of force.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute identifying the author; the creator is automatically confirmed by default but can be changed.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute for additional personal change rights without relevance within the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute identifying reviewers assigned for review.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute identifying releasers assigned for release, including translation.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute affecting e-mail notification for assigned user groups and persons when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute affecting distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks when the next version is released.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate validity; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which invalidated documents are archived; can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Original language version used before translation and required to be released for translation.

attributes.name: language_version
attributes.description: Language-dependent version displayed to authorized readers after release.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of clients in which the document is visible or not.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures within a framework or process sequence, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create new documents or to add information objects to documents.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents, including Excel, Word and PowerPoint.

attributes.name: format_name
attributes.description: Name of the Office format such as Excel, Word or PowerPoint.

objs.name: source_format
objs.description: Existing format used by the editing client to open the document in the corresponding local Office component.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted representation of the saved document displayed on the web.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Object type used to supplement a document with additional information not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: released
attributes.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Attachments are subject to their own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Attachments pass through all statuses of the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: archived
attributes.description: Released attachments can be marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next version of the main document.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment mentioned as additional information or equipment relevant to documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual user or person participating in document management, workflows, authorizations and distribution.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION to provide functions appropriate to the area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: Role shown in brackets for system roles.

attributes.name: read_permission
attributes.description: Permission to read a document or related details.

attributes.name: write_permission
attributes.description: Permission to change a document or related details.

attributes.name: author_right
attributes.description: Right allowing employees to create change proposals.

attributes.name: write_access
attributes.description: Access allowing users to create a request for AKS for a selected document.

attributes.name: login_language
attributes.description: Language used for visibility of released translated documents.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorization, reader assignment, distribution and dashboards.

attributes.name: read_authorization
attributes.description: Authorization automatically received by user groups assigned to the distribution.

objs.name: authorization_group
objs.description: Group defined in the system and assigned to documents to grant read and change rights to users or persons.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing user groups and persons for distribution, acknowledgement and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Documented confirmation by users taking note of documents.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Acknowledgements are listed depending on status.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document, belonging to a document and managed in the document cockpit.

attributes.name: completed
attributes.description: Completed change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system before document validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document through the Override process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for reactivation of invalidated documents.

attributes.name: initiator
attributes.description: Creator of the request for reactivation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, acknowledgement and other workflow-supported processes.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status and existence of workflow tasks are communicated to users.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: E-mail used to inform involved users about workflow tasks, document releases, change proposals and distribution.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

attributes.name: selection_parameter
attributes.description: Parameter used to influence evaluation results.

attributes.name: selection_criterion
attributes.description: Criterion used to filter result lists.

attributes.name: traffic_light_system
attributes.description: Status display used in reports based on validity or workflow timing.

objs.name: document_list
objs.description: Reader dashboard listing all documents relevant to the user.

objs.name: instruction
objs.description: Instruction stored in the system and evaluated in status reports.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent translated version or content of a released document requiring workflow-supported checking and release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be linked or to which regulations may relate.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be linked, including IT applications.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be linked.
